physics_configuration.engine: torchfdtd.Simulation, 2D TE (Ez), staircase Yee sampling, courant_factor 0.99, mesh 0.025 um (dt 5.837669e-17 s), precision float64 on CPU
physics_configuration.pml_profile: default BoundaryFace: layers 10 (0.25 um), sigma_scale 1, kappa 1, alpha 1e-8, polynomial 3, alpha_polynomial 0

long_reference_domain.note: same x_min distance, same mesh nodes, same source and monitor indices; its own x_max echo cannot reach the monitor within the run, so short - long is exactly the short domain's x_max CPML return and the x_min echo cancels

normal_and_interface.note: one-cycle Gaussian at 193.4 THz with the C1 endpoint taper so the drive starts at exactly zero; amplitude 1; soft sheet (radiates both ways)

oblique.note: three-cycle Gaussian at 206.8 THz with the C1 endpoint taper, centred in the oblique band 1.3 to 1.6 um; the 60 deg design is grazing at 1.79 um where this pulse has 5e-4 of its peak amplitude
fixed k_parallel; 1.8 um would be grazing (sin theta = 1.006) for the 60 deg design, so the oblique band stops at 1.6 um; R at exactly 1.55 um (the design angle) is recorded separately

interface.description: n=2 rectangle filling y from -0.9875 to 0.0125 um across the whole x range including both CPMLs; vacuum elsewhere; the interface enters the x CPML layers

frequencies.spacing: uniform in frequency from c/1.8 um to c/1.3 um

depth_sweep.note: separate sweep at fixed mesh and time; the criterion applies to the default 10 layers

time_sweep.note: separate sweep; the reflected pulse is fully recorded within 100 fs, so both durations should agree

stability.energy: state_norm of the run-control diagnostics every 100 steps: sum eps |E|^2 + |H|^2 over the volume including the CPML memory
stability.note: the 60 deg run uses the oblique pulse; its grazing components (about 5e-4 of the peak amplitude, beyond 1.79 um) are slow and are not absorbed like propagating waves, so that run is judged on non-growth only

layer_A.description: short vacuum normal fixture rerun on CUDA FP32 with the CUDA graph; raw trace / FP64 peak compared to CPU FP64

reference_method: reflected/incident power ratio R(f) = |DFT(short - long)(f)|^2 / |DFT(long)(f)|^2 at the monitor, DFT written in the test; broadband energy ratio sum (short-long)^2 / sum long^2 over the whole trace; no analytic oracle is needed, the long domain is the reference

observables.name: R_max_on_band
observables.definition: max over the declared band of R(f)

observables.name: R_broadband
observables.definition: time-domain energy ratio over the whole trace

observables.name: energy_last_over_peak
observables.definition: state_norm at the last diagnostic over the maximum state_norm of the run

observables.name: late_growth
observables.definition: max state_norm over the second half of the run divided by max(state_norm at the half-way diagnostic, 1e-12 x peak state_norm); the floor (1e-6 in field amplitude) keeps FP64 round-off noise, which the vacuum run reaches at about 1e-17 of its peak, from being read as growth

observables.name: layer_A_trace_error
observables.definition: CUDA FP32 trace / FP64 peak against CPU FP64 trace / FP64 peak

normal.applies_to: vacuum and n=2, 10 layers, band 1.3 to 1.8 um

oblique.applies_to: 30 and 60 deg designs, band 1.3 to 1.6 um

interface.note: this case's own budget: the declared-oblique limit, because the field at the interface reaches the layer at every angle

stability.applies_to: energy_last_over_peak for the two normal-incidence runs; late_growth for all three runs (the 60 deg run reports energy_last_over_peak only)

acceptance_limits.sweeps: reported only: 20 layers must not reflect more than 10 layers; 200 fs must agree with 100 fs to within 10 percent of R
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds pml_normal_reflected_power_ratio and pml_declared_oblique_reflected_power_ratio; the interface and stability budgets are this case's own pre-declared limits
